def evolved_p88(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # x[i, j] = i XOR j via per-bit decomposition
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device)
    ii = idx.view(N, 1)
    jj = idx.view(1, N)
    nbits = max(1, (N - 1).bit_length())
    res = None
    for b in range(nbits):
        p = 1 << b
        bit = ((ii // p) % 2 + (jj // p) % 2) % 2
        term = bit * p
        res = term if res is None else res + term
    return res.to(x.dtype)

def evolved_p88(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # x[i, j] = i XOR j, vectorized over bits
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device)
    nbits = max(1, (N - 1).bit_length())
    powers = torch.tensor([1 << b for b in range(nbits)], device=x.device)
    bi = (idx.view(N, 1, 1) // powers) % 2
    bj = (idx.view(1, N, 1) // powers) % 2
    xor = (bi + bj) % 2
    return (xor * powers).sum(-1).to(x.dtype)
